items.caption: A Western Zhou bronze-script form of 差, redrawn from a form associated with 同簋蓋. Its unusual strokes belong to the disputed early graphic history of the character.
items.alt: Black, angular bronze-script glyph centered on a white background, with radiating upper strokes and a long vertical lower stroke crossed by two horizontal strokes.
items.selection_reason: This candidate provides a useful visual example of a catalogued Western Zhou form. The proposed interpretations of its components remain contested.

limitations.text: This is a modern vector redraw, not an artifact image. The form’s shape alone cannot establish whether 差 depicts bundled fuel, misaligned hands, wheat rubbing, or another interpretation.
